product_overview: Cominorsa is a consulting website for mining-related services, helping prospective clients learn about offerings, review FAQs and legal information, and start a consultation through WhatsApp. The site also captures consultation leads through a background CRM request when users submit the inquiry form.
core_goals: Discover the company’s mining consulting services
Review detailed information about a specific service
Submit a consultation inquiry and continue the conversation in WhatsApp
Find answers in the FAQ section
Read privacy policy and terms information

features.name: Consultation form and WhatsApp lead capture
features.description: Users can describe their consulting need, choose a service, and send the inquiry to WhatsApp with a prefilled message while the site also attempts to capture the lead in the CRM.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the consultation section -> Fill in full name -> Fill in city or region -> Select a service of interest -> Select a WhatsApp line -> Write a consultation message -> Submit the form -> See a new WhatsApp chat open with a prefilled message -> See the confirmation message that the message was prepared and sent to WhatsApp

Navigate to / -> Scroll to the consultation section -> Fill in full name -> Fill in city or region -> Leave the service of interest unselected -> Write a consultation message -> Submit the form -> See validation that the required service selection is missing

Navigate to / -> Scroll to the consultation section -> Fill in full name -> Fill in city or region -> Select a service of interest -> Select a WhatsApp line -> Write a short consultation message -> Submit the form -> See validation that the message is too short

features.name: Site navigation
features.description: Users can move through the homepage sections with anchor links, open the WhatsApp contact shortcut, and use the mobile menu to access the same destinations.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the WhatsApp contact shortcut in the header -> See a new WhatsApp chat open in a new tab with a prefilled contact message
Navigate to / -> Click the Services navigation link -> Scroll to the services section
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile navigation menu -> Move through the menu links until focus wraps back to the start -> Close the menu with Escape -> See the panel dismiss

features.name: Service detail pages
features.description: Users can open a detailed page for each available consulting service, review what is included, and start a service-specific WhatsApp conversation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the services section -> Open a service from the services grid -> Review the service details -> Click the WhatsApp conversation link -> See a new WhatsApp chat open with a prefilled message for that service
Navigate to /igafom-reinfo -> Review the service details -> Click the link to return to all services -> Scroll back to the homepage services section

features.name: FAQ page
features.description: Users can open the frequently asked questions page and read common questions and answers about the consulting services.
user_flows: Navigate to /preguntas-frecuentes -> Read the FAQ questions and answers

features.name: Legal pages
features.description: Users can open the privacy policy and terms pages to review the site’s legal information.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacidad -> Read the privacy policy content
Navigate to /terminos -> Read the terms and conditions content

features.name: Cookie consent banner
features.description: Visitors can choose whether to allow analytics cookies, and their choice is remembered for future visits.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the cookie consent banner -> Accept analytics cookies -> See the banner dismiss and analytics load
Navigate to / -> See the cookie consent banner -> Reject analytics cookies -> See the banner dismiss
Navigate to / -> See the cookie consent banner -> Open the privacy policy from the banner -> Read the privacy policy page
Navigate to / -> Accept or reject the cookie banner -> Reload the page -> See that the banner does not appear again

routes.description: Homepage with hero, about, services grid, consultation form and contact sections
Service detail page — DAC and ESTAMIN declarations
Service detail page — mining engineering and mine plans
Service detail page — mining safety and monthly consulting

features.name: Consultation form (WhatsApp lead capture)
features.description: Client fills a form describing their consulting need; on submit it opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat and fires a background lead-capture request to the CRM. Uses a `mounted` gate to disable the submit button until React hydration attaches the real handler, preventing a native (GET, query-string) form submission on an early click.
user_interactions: Fill "Nombre completo" text input (required)
Fill "Ciudad o región" text input (required)
Select "Servicio de interés" from a dropdown (required, must not stay on the disabled placeholder option)
Select "Línea de WhatsApp" (defaults to primary number)
Fill "Escribe tu consulta" textarea (required, minLength 10)
Click "Enviar por WhatsApp" submit button (disabled until client hydration completes)
Observe a new tab/window open to wa.me with a prefilled message
See the aria-live status text "Tu mensaje fue preparado y enviado a WhatsApp." after submit

features.name: CRM lead capture API
features.description: Route handler that forwards a consultation form submission to a Twenty CRM instance as a Person record. No-ops (returns 200 {"ok":true}) whenever TWENTY_API_KEY/TWENTY_API_URL are unset, the body is malformed, or the upstream call fails — it never surfaces an error to the client.

features.name: Site navigation (desktop + mobile)
features.description: Sticky header with anchor links to homepage sections and a WhatsApp CTA; a mobile hamburger menu with a focus-trapped, ESC-closable panel and scrollbar-compensation to avoid layout shift.
user_interactions: Click "Nosotros", "Servicios", "Consulta", "Contacto" nav links to scroll to sections
Click header "WhatsApp" CTA to open wa.me in a new tab
Click the hamburger button to open/close the mobile nav panel
Press Escape to close the mobile nav panel
Tab through mobile nav links to confirm focus trap wraps at first/last link

features.name: Service detail pages
features.description: Six static service pages rendered from a shared data source (services-data.ts) via a common ServicePageLayout, each listing what the service includes and a WhatsApp CTA prefilled with a service-specific message.
user_interactions: Navigate to a service page from the homepage services grid
Click "Hablar por WhatsApp" to open a prefilled wa.me chat for that service
Click "ver todos los servicios" link back to the homepage services section

features.name: Cookie consent banner
features.description: Fixed-position banner shown until the visitor accepts or rejects analytics cookies; choice persisted in localStorage. Accepting loads Google Analytics (GA4) via next/script with a CSP nonce; the page body reserves extra space while the banner is visible so it doesn't cover the footer.
user_interactions: See the cookie banner on first visit (no stored consent)
Click "Aceptar" to grant consent and load GA4
Click "Rechazar" to deny consent and dismiss the banner
Click the "Política de Privacidad" link inside the banner
Reload the page and confirm the banner does not reappear after a choice was made

features.name: FAQ page
features.description: Static frequently-asked-questions page for prospective clients.
user_interactions: Navigate to the FAQ page and read question/answer content

features.name: Legal pages
features.description: Static privacy policy and terms & conditions pages.
user_interactions: Navigate to /privacidad and /terminos and read legal content

known_limitations.issue: CRM lead capture is fire-and-forget and always reports success
known_limitations.impact: A UI/E2E test cannot observe CRM delivery failure or success from the client; the endpoint always returns 200 {"ok":true} regardless of outcome, and the fetch call's rejection is silently swallowed on the client

known_limitations.issue: Submit button is intentionally disabled until client hydration completes
known_limitations.impact: A test that clicks submit immediately after page load without waiting for hydration will find the button disabled — this is by design, not a bug

known_limitations.issue: WhatsApp submission opens a new browser tab/window
known_limitations.impact: Automated tests must handle a popup/new-tab (wa.me) rather than same-tab navigation when verifying the WhatsApp handoff
